complexity.notes: The compressed one-liner style hurts readability and obscures the algorithm; precomputing prefix/suffix maxima (or using two pointers) would reduce this to O(n) time. The slice height[0:i] also allocates an O(n) copy per iteration, though max() could consume a view-free iterator instead.
complexity.summary: For each bar, recomputes the max of the left slice and the max of the right slice from scratch, then adds min(left_max, right_max) - height[i] when positive. This brute-force rescans O(n) elements per bar, giving quadratic time.
